scientific_scope: Population stimulation of NP3056-Gal4 ChR+ LNs and average postsynaptic outward current in ChR-negative LNs; no unitary synapse, fitted model or exact MaleCNS subtype assignment

actions: Inspect Figure6 vector/raster object inventory without exporting neural-trace vertices
Read text, axes, scale bars and light-command geometry
Record visible time windows relative to illustrated shutter command if scale calibration is unambiguous
Keep reported protocol facts and geometry-inferred values separate

future_data_units.C: example whole-cell voltage, mV; context only, no spike detection from publication plot
future_data_units.D: across-cell mean outward current and SEM, pA, n=9; separate no-Gal4 control n=6
future_data_units.E: across-cell mean firing rate and SEM, spikes/s, n=5
future_data_units.F: onset expansion of D, same data; consistency check only

future_primary_traces: D gray SEM envelope if separable
D blue control mean/envelope if separable
E SEM envelope only if recoverable
excluded: A/B ORN-evoked EPSCs and their depression fits; F is not an independent cohort; do not turn C example spikes into the n=5 E dataset

coordinates.retain: PDF point units, page box, transforms, object index/style, native path vertices and source hash if phase2 proceeds
coordinates.prefer: native vector centerlines and SEM filled bounds; never fit smooth curves
coordinates.raster_fallback: Only if vector attribution fails; preserve lossless rendered page, fixed crop and calibration anchors; report line-width/pixel intervals, not exact biological samples
coordinates.time_zero: illustrated light-command rising edge, explicitly not measured photon onset or spike onset
coordinates.time_units: D/C share 1s scale bar; E/F share expanded 200ms bar after geometry/visual confirmation
coordinates.current_scale: 4pA bar in D and separately F; vertical origin must be baseline subtraction, because no absolute holding-current axis exists
coordinates.never_assume: figure9 whole-cell holding voltage from Figure5 settings

future_alignment_and_measurement.warning: E and D/F are different cell cohorts; aggregate comparison cannot identify a causal kernel or per-spike gain
future_alignment_and_measurement.interpolation: Only linear interpolation for explicit matched display-time comparison after retaining original vertices; no extrapolation
future_alignment_and_measurement.window_rationale: Predetermined onset-region summaries after visual layout inspection, not optimized from trace values; exclude shutter transition and the nominal 50ms half-width of reported acausal PSTH smoothing
future_alignment_and_measurement.window_gate: If layout inventory shows any window outside panel support, stop and version a revised plan before extracting traces
future_alignment_and_measurement.allowed_summaries: signed early-to-late differences for each cohort separately, with extraction uncertainty; no amplitude normalization that invents shared units
future_alignment_and_measurement.uncertainty: Do not treat SEM envelopes as simultaneous confidence bands, recover individual trials from means, or estimate inferential p-values from digitized means alone

aggregation_and_filters_to_preserve: D n=9 and control n=6; E n=5, mean±SEM across cells
General PSTH: 1ms bins, 1–6 trials per stimulus, 100ms zero-centered Hanning; exact Figure6 repeat counts not specified
General recording lowpass2kHz, digitization10kHz; display downsampling1kHz; exact current/SEM preprocessing not individually stated
identity_limits: no specific receptor isolation or native reversal established
failure_preservation: Never overwrite frozen plan or extraction evidence; preserve ambiguous path classification, unavailable SEM, unsupported window, clipping and source/geometry failures. A revised plan must be a separately named version with reason and prior hash.
prohibitions: no neural or body model run
no mechanistic selection between release facilitation and delayed receptor access
no second paper acquisition in this task
